handoff.trigger: one fully completed qualifying parent nominal matrix bound to a checkpoint; no prediction of update number or rewrite of parent course state
handoff.source_selection: one complete original-protocol matrix passing every command of the entry stage; bind raw/checkpoint SHA explicitly before future handoff
handoff.pending_next_speed_stage: record but do not sample during initial DR acquisition
handoff.parent_stop: normal settlement before source changes or new submission; no watcher installed by this design
handoff.parent_consumption: preserve actual charged updates and wall time; no implicit balance transfer or reset
handoff.active_parent_policy: frozen v1 still requires two confirmations; new design does not hot-edit it

budget.meaning_of_null: pending explicit allocation, not unlimited authorization

preserved.reward: source actual reward, weights, formulas, dt and evidence-driven mixtures
preserved.plane_and_asset: parent identity; no new contact/solver/material settings in first DR phase
preserved.Actor_previous: last PD-adopted physical target; not sensor-delayed, measured-wheel substituted or shadow-fed
preserved.command_and_task_inputs: current declared command; original Motion/NONE encoding

motion_domain_randomization.cross_command_allocation: exact integer command-by-DR quotas; preserve +/- pairs and rotate rounding ties
motion_domain_randomization.sampling: reset-only; fixed parameters within each episode; new level affects future resets only
motion_domain_randomization.zero_strength: exact parent nominal; do not draw or advance policy RNG
motion_domain_randomization.integer_interpolation: integer center +/- floor(full_half_width_ms * strength), inclusive uniform; no fractional-age interpolation

actor_packet_age.imu_and_joint_age: same draw in first version; synchronous first16 physical fields
actor_packet_age.updated_fields: gyro/gravity/q/dq only; preserve units, axes and scales
actor_packet_age.query: at each 100Hz policy query, encode a real stored state acquired at query_time-age
actor_packet_age.acquisition_phase: episode-constant phase implied by age modulo 10ms; not extra random transport
actor_packet_age.implementation_required: timestamped 1ms raw physical history; current SensorPackets alone cannot represent 8/12ms
actor_packet_age.reset: fill with actual initialized state and expose history_ready/actual_age; no prior-episode data or zero gravity

target_transport.correlation: one common offset across six channels; preserve measured side ordering
target_transport.quantization: FIFO arrival on 1ms clock; target first adopted on a 5ms PD tick
target_transport.no_double_count: 7/11ms remain transport hypotheses, wheel torque tau stays0; do not add another7/11ms response

PD_feedback_age.correlation: one age for synchronous six-channel q/dq feedback
PD_feedback_age.query: actual 1ms history at each5ms PD tick; not Actor observation age
PD_feedback_age.out_of_scope: 20ms whole-body failure cases remain separate stress tests, not first training range

motion_domain_randomization.previous_at_first_level: nominal; deduplicate equal evaluation conditions by identity and retain group references
motion_domain_randomization.provenance: engineering prior around current successful simulation, not identified real hardware bounds

curriculum.initial_skill_stage: the entry stage passed by the source at nominal; use exact evidence rather than assume future promotion
curriculum.DR_ACQUIRE: hold C_k and attempt exactly the next R level; one complete passing matrix certifies it, then add exactly the next command amplitude at unchanged DR
curriculum.COMMAND_ACQUIRE: freeze current certified DR; learn C_k including all lower endpoints; one complete passing matrix then attempts exactly one next R level at unchanged C_k
curriculum.COMMAND_REPAIR: after measured mastered-command regression, reduce active command ceiling by one; keep current parameters and DR; one full recovery pass restores one command level toward the interrupted target, without increasing DR
curriculum.FINAL_CONSOLIDATE: maximum command and final DR jointly passed; maintain final motion ability within budget; measured mastered-command regression repairs one command level lower without lowering DR
curriculum.retain: zero plus every endpoint within the active command ceiling; archived evidence and mixtures for temporarily excluded higher commands remain intact
curriculum.tail_rule: if one axis reaches its maximum, hold it fixed while completing remaining levels of the other axis

command_rollback.reference: mastered commands with complete passing evidence at the same certified DR/scoring; in COMMAND_ACQUIRE these are C_(k-1), not the new four endpoints
command_rollback.measured_regression: any original required gate explicitly fails for a mastered command with valid physical evidence; behavior-caused early termination is a known failure, never a shortened passing window
command_rollback.new_endpoint_failure: hold current command level and continue learning; it is not loss of an already mastered ability
command_rollback.stage0_failure: remain at C0 and continue repair under the same DR; never invent a negative command stage
command_rollback.checkpoint_anchor: keep last passing checkpoint as an evidence/recovery anchor, not an automatic parameter rewind
command_rollback.pending_target: preserve the interrupted command target; recover one command level at a time before resuming it
command_rollback.duplicate_or_stale_evaluation: do not repeat a rollback for the same evaluation; conflicting identity is an engineering error

DR_rollback.failure_in_DR_ACQUIRE: hold skill and attempted DR level, continue learning
DR_rollback.failure_in_COMMAND_modes: DR level, family ranges, DR-group quotas and random streams stay fixed while command level retreats
DR_rollback.certified_DR_level: monotone high-water mark; historical confirmation does not claim the current model still passes
DR_rollback.nominal_and_previous_groups: always retained; 25/25/50 sampling is not a DR-level retreat

evaluation_priority: engineering or physical fault uses original protection
incomplete/mismatched evidence or UNKNOWN holds state without promotion or rollback
one known mastered-command regression in command learning, repair or final motion maintenance rolls back exactly one command level
a complete passing matrix advances only one difficulty axis
new-command-only failure or DR-stage behavior failure keeps learning at the same level
curriculum.certificate_scope: each passing checkpoint is bound to exact skill ceiling, DR level, parameter table and scoring; one seed is a stage result, not robust real-hardware certification
curriculum.episode_quality_termination: unchanged; failed transitions retained with original bootstrap semantics

evaluation.current_table: full-range low/high corners plus six independent counter draws; record actual distinct parameter count
evaluation.table_seed: different declared evaluation stream at every checkpoint; never training RNG
evaluation.requirement: 8/8 per command per group; all original physical/tracking/posture/symmetry gates
confirmations_require: all required cases with valid original30s window evidence or explicit behavior termination failure
evaluation.UNKNOWN: not passed, no promotion; do not label as measured behavior failure
evaluation.scoring_version: parent motion31_posture_reacquisition_assessment_v1 checks, extended with explicit DR identity
evaluation.grouping: reuse existing4-case/64-env layout only after per-env parameter and reset readback; preserve8 scored per case
evaluation.source_evaluation: strictly reference matching parent nominal raw evidence; new DR skill failure does not block learning; new timing path still requires wiring readback
evaluation.behavior_regression_scope: old mastered commands only; do not equate missing data or unlearned new endpoints with regression
evaluation.promotion_note: one complete matrix replaces two confirmations for this future recipe only; 8env and physical/quality thresholds unchanged

critic.existing_timing_features: 6 transport ages,1 PD feedback age,6 torque response times,actual torque,adopted-requested targets
critic.additional_true_state: current first16 physical frame and actual armature remain available
critic.actor_packet_age_and_full_pending_queue: not explicitly observed by current140D Critic; record as known partial-observability limitation
critic.next_revision_if_needed: only after persistent per-group EV/MSE failure, design a separate explicit privileged interface

every_checkpoint: tracking by command and DR group
Critic EV/MSE/return variance by command and DR group
sample counts and actual parameter/age distribution
diagnostics.performance: retain v2/hotpath/GPU statistics; cache raw state on GPU, transform delayed frame at100Hz; no physics-step CPU material or history copies
diagnostics.new_root_history: reuse joint12 ring; add root quaternion4 plus world angular velocity3; initial planning32 slots at1ms
diagnostics.full_trace_policy: reuse compact scored-only raw NPZ; JSON references once, no embedded arrays or whole-source copies
diagnostics.storage_limit: must recompute for up to3x original scoring cases; old13GiB is not automatically sufficient

deferred_disabled.mass_COM: pending measurement and correct inertia-frame mapping
deferred_disabled.events_push_terrain: later separate versions after flat timing robustness
deferred_disabled.packet_jitter_drops_noise: pending measured statistics; not added to first version
